decisions.reason: This industrial AC input module is a core automation building block with its own product-page presence and fits the firm's modular platform and in-house production strengths.
The four-channel solid state relay module closely complements the firm's established control hardware, so it remains a natural part of the portfolio.

The server room monitoring kit is more solution-specific and less central than the core modules, but it still leverages the firm's existing sensing platform and is inexpensive to retain in a growing broad-range offer.

The RGB LED control module is somewhat more niche and only newly introduced, yet it still builds on the firm's modular electronics ecosystem and is not far enough from the core offer to justify an early withdrawal.
The remote access service for wallboxes directly supports the firm's stated expansion in charging and energy management, making it strategically important to keep.
